content.text:
Not on `main` — but yes, Marc-Antoine has it on unmerged branches.

**On `main` today:** `apps/website/app/api/supabase/*` only. The node-ish ones (`content`, `document`, `space`, `platform-account`) are per-row CRUD by id — `GET /api/supabase/content/[id]` etc. There's no "give me the nodes in a space" endpoint.

**On Marc-Antoine's branches** (`origin/validation`, `origin/mira-rt`, `origin/mira-collab` — all pushed today, all carrying the same commits) there are three new routes, JSON-LD shaped, built for the MIRA demo:

- `GET /api/data/[space_id]` — lists every concept in a space as a JSON-LD `Container`, each entry `{@id, modified}`. Supports `?after=<date>` for incremental sync (checks both `my_concepts` and `my_contents` last_modified). Also has a `POST` that ingests JSON-LD back in via `populate()`.
- `GET /api/data/[space_id]/[resource_id]` — one node as JSON-LD, with `?format=`, `?context=`, `?schema=`.
- `GET /api/content/[space_id]/[resource_id]` — the same node rendered as a document (`?format=html|...`, `?data=false` to drop the embedded data).

Reads go through `my_concepts` / `Concept` + `Content`, so RLS decides visibility.

**Caveats:** none of this is in a PR. His two open JSON-LD PRs ([#529](https://github.com/DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph/pull/529), [#659](https://github.com/DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph/pull/659)) are from Dec 2025 / Jan 2026 and don't contain these routes. Branch tip is `wip`, and the resource route has a commented-out space-not-found check with a note that it just guesses `Obsidian` "for MIRA demo". So: it exists and works, but it's demo-grade and unreviewed.

Want me to diff `validation` against `main` properly, or ask Marc-Antoine what the intended shipping path is?
